remarks: Life happens, and opportunity knocks! Don't miss what may be the first resale opportunity in the newly completed Fresco del Sol community in East Ventura. This highly desirable Plan 8 floor plan offers exceptional flexibility with a first-floor bedroom featuring a walk-in closet and full bath, plus an additional downstairs guest bath, making it ideal for guests, multi-generational living, or a home office. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious primary suite designed as a private retreat with a luxurious en-suite bath, soaking tub, oversized walk-in shower, and generous walk-in closet.
